correctness.rationale: For T≥1 and two agent matchings partitioning 2T goods into disjoint pairs, any T completed recipient-valued pairs partition all goods; an alternating cycle must be assigned wholly by one color, so full welfare T is fair iff cycle half-lengths have an almost-balanced subset split (total discrepancy ≤1). If this fails, greedily distribute all but one largest component, cut it into L-1 disjoint colored pairs with two leftovers; choosing the cut near balance and giving leftovers to smaller-value recipient ensures for every deleted item the other-valued bundle ≤floor((size-1)/2), hence strong EFX and welfare T-1. EF1 cannot exceed T except at the same criterion. Standard subset sum DP yields O(T²) witnessing assignment. Independently enumerated 235 labeled ordered pairs of matchings on 2,4,6 goods with all allocation EFX tests; formula passed. Strong all-goods EFX convention and common-edge doubled cycles included.
